name: Dirt Bike
description: A motor-powered vehicle with two or more tires, designed to travel over any terrain and capable of travelling off paved roads, whether or not it can be ridden legally on a street; one of Mississippi's off-road vehicles, with ATVs and recreational off-highway vehicles. Electric bicycles are excluded.

restrictions.rule: Two or more tires and designed to travel over any terrain, whether or not it may be ridden legally on a public street
No limit on motor power or speed
An electric bicycle is kept out of the off-road vehicle, dirt bike and ATV laws

On public property, the rider needs a driver's license or a certificate from an off-road vehicle safety course taught through the Cooperative Extension Service or another organization the Department of Public Safety approves
On public property, every rider and passenger under 16 must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218
The off-road vehicle law doesn't authorize riding it on a public road or highway
